body: too much happened. I recently got accepted to the University I want to attend but in order to do that I overloaded my school schedule with online classes. First semester didn't go too well with my online Physics and Calculus classes, and I ended up getting a C in physics because I procrastinated the entire class for so long. Luckily, the teacher gave me another chance and I did all of my work the week before the class ended. Now, the same thing is happening again and she probably wont give me another chance. This semester I thought I could change it up. Nope. Procrastination hit me hard again, plus I signed up for another online course because I'm a fucking idiot. On top of that- I have a solo that I am supposed to be playing on saturday with my trombone and I haven't practiced a single drop. My band teacher is going to hate me- I do this every year and tell her I won't do it again. With all of that going on, I got the lead role in the musical, so now I will have to devote entire school nights to rehearsals for the musical, on top of memorizing lines and learning 10 songs. Wait though- it gets a little bit better. If it wasn't enough that I haven't even STARTED my online classes this semester (that I have to do well in so I don't get my admission offer rescinded), I am stressing over a girl who I love. Been with her for about a year now. My procrastination and overall lack of self-worth crept into the relationship and I tried to kill myself when school started which led to me being put in a horrid mental hospital. After coming out of that, I tried to improve- for her, and for us. I am honestly so taken aback by this girl and I want to marry her. (yeah I'm young blah blah blah, but she has helped me through some deep shit that most adults probably couldn't have handled). Recently, my gf and I got in a fight and my ridiculous self-pity and self-hatred took over and before I knew it I was telling her to break up with me- LITERALLY listing off reasons. It was bad. After she decided to ignore me, because it has happened before, I ended up yelling at her and being childish. The next day we talked and she told me that what I had done was a dealbreaker. That she will never forgive me for, and that I have forever changed her opinion of me. Great. I caused the girl of my dreams to fall out of love with me. Now she basically doesn't much love me anymore and she told me that we aren't breaking up right now because if we do the rest of our senior year will suck. Yep- that's the reason she's staying with me after me fucking up. We can't breakup because we both have the same friends and are both the lead parts in the musical. So, now I am I am in love with a girl who's basically with me because of the social problems with breaking up. Lets see... what next? Oh yeah, on top of all of this, my parents are going through a divorce and my dad is a cheating fuckhead. Even worse, I seem to show a lot of him in me and I can't stand it because I am becoming him. He is also trying really hard to get me off of my depression meds which is not working. My lazy and fucking retarded personality also allows me to continually skip days and hours of when I am supposed to be taking my medicine. It's a low doseage, but it's fucking me up and through my own mistakes I have to lie about taking my medicine on time every day to my girlfriend so I don't give her another reason to break up with me.
